zh: 另一台电脑上的助手，两边现在是同一张脸；不在本机的多一圈虚线边框。
问另一台电脑的助手失败时会换个方式再试，最多三次，并留下原因。
配对的电脑可以只读地查你共享的项目；谁问过，设置里看得到。
en: An assistant on another computer has one face on both; a dashed ring marks it as remote.
A failed ask to another computer retries another way, up to three times, and keeps the reason.
A paired computer can read a project you shared, read-only; Settings shows who asked.
